Unit Data Owner and coordinator, incl. coordination of all unit data governance related tasks.

Managing accounting and financial risk and providing advice and guidance on strategic initiatives (driven by internal policies and/or external regulation) and new products that impact the entities /processes /utilities with their remit
Collaborating with relevant stakeholders to provide comprehensive financial reporting and analysis
Developing innovative business solutions and providing strategic advice and guidance to support the execution of business strategy, mitigation of risks and achievement of the bank’s/regions’/Division’s objectives

A healthy, engaged and well-supported workforce are better equipped to do their best work and, more importantly, enjoy their lives inside and outside the workplace. That’s why we are committed to providing an environment with your development and wellbeing at its centre.
You can expect:
Supplemental Savings Plan on top of mandatory social security
20 days of annual paid leave, plus public holiday & Flexible Working Arrangement
A range of competitive benefits to suit your needs
On-line family doctor consultation for both employee & family members
Employee Assistance Program for both employee & family members

This role is to efficiently deliver Regulatory Reporting front to back. Accountable for all aspects of production of Reg Reports from report production to data submission to process efficiency to explain any queries arise internally and externally.
Head of Regulatory Reporting (1104), PBOC, SAFE and other reg reporting
Collaborate with business and infrastructure partners to deliver values to the bank
Deliver results on projects and initiatives through AI/Innovation
Has good understanding of regulatory reporting rules
Maintain effective relationship with regulators
Accountable for Reg Reporting quality, accuracy and timeliness

15 years+ post qualified experience in a Finance, Control or other Analytical area within a financial institution.
Hands-on experiences on local regulatory reporting / dealing with regulators' requests
Good working knowledge in managing process and validation
Good Chinese and English writing to identifying issues and problem solving
Data and Technology experience is a plus
Financial control and leadership
Project management to lead changes on process, systems, people, solution, sourcing
AI Automation & streamline the process
Interpreting local regulatory rules and market practices
Strategic thinking and realization
Business judgment and acumen
Team work
Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimize workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs

Flexible working to assist you balance your personal priorities
Coaching and support from experts in your team
A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs
Training and development to help you excel in your career

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
Lead Architect
.
Business: CTO Data Technology
Job ID: 59116
Principal Responsibilities
Support a team of Data Architects in designing and implementing data architecture solutions that align with business objectives, technology strategy, and industry best practices.
Help define and communicate the strategic vision for data architecture, considering data governance, data integration, data modelling, and data management. Ensure that the design approaches align with this vision.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand data requirements, translate them into actionable data architecture designs, and influence the development of data solutions.
Ensure data integrity and security by establishing data governance frameworks, data quality standards, and data protection measures.
Drive the adoption of data best practices, data standards, and data management processes across the team.
Provide guidance and mentorship to the team, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
Stay up to date with emerging data technologies, trends, and industry developments. Evaluate and recommend new tools and methodologies to enhance data architecture capabilities.
Requirements
Leadership: You possess strong leadership skills, enabling you to support and inspire a team of Data Architects. You can effectively communicate the strategic vision and guide the team towards achieving data architecture excellence.
Data Architecture Expertise: You have a deep understanding of data architecture principles, data modelling, data integration, and data management. You can design scalable and efficient data solutions that meet business requirements.
Communication with Impact: Your communication skills are strong, allowing you to effectively convey complex data architecture concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You can influence and align stakeholders towards the defined data architecture strategies.
Consulting: You demonstrate strong consulting skills, leveraging your expertise to provide valuable insights and guidance to cross-functional teams. You can identify opportunities for improvement and drive data architecture excellence.
Relationship/Stakeholder Management: You excel in managing relationships and stakeholders at various levels, establishing trust and collaboration to drive successful outcomes. You can effectively navigate and influence within a complex organisational structure.
Problem Solving: Your problem-solving skills are expert level, enabling you to analyse complex data challenges and develop innovative solutions. You can guide the team in overcoming technical obstacles and making informed decisions.
Data Governance: You have a strong understanding of data governance principles and can establish and enforce data governance frameworks, data quality standards, and data protection measures.
Data Modeling: Expertise in conceptual, logical, and physical data modeling. Familiarity with tools like ERwin, Visual Paradigm, PowerDesigner, or Sparx Enterprise Architect.
Data Warehousing & ETL:Knowledge of data warehouse design. Experience with ETL tools (Informatica, Talend, SSIS) and data integration. Familiarity with Hadoop ecosystem, Spark, Kafka, and cloud data platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).
//WX

Business

Ensure the accuracy of regulatory reports and their delivery within deadline

Be a great team worker and contribute to a achieving a great place to work.
Ensure the continuous self-development as per agreed growth plan
Be instrumental in a team of operations professionals and generate talents.
Work as a team and train fellow teammates

Operate within the risk and control framework, i.e. assist team lead to minimize operational loss and manage regulatory breach, ensure no high-risk testing issue and/or material audit finding
Escalate risk issues for immediate resolution and closure.
Governance
Aware of resources across the organization and attract the best to work in the team
Accountable for implementing and complying with AML requirements when performing duties.

Be part of Fund & Fiduciary Operations to achieve the outcomes set out in the Bank’s Conduct Principles: Fair Outcomes for Clients; Effective Financial Markets; Financial Crime Compliance; The Right Environment.
Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

CMS, client service manager, client onboarding manager, sales

Understand, acknowledge and comply with the requirements on individual accountabilities and responsibilities of the job set out in applicable local laws and regulations as well as SCB internal policies.
Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities.
Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank.

Accounting

Fund Operation
